<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_MarketingCampaign"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing Campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Process starts"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create campaign content"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CampaignWorkSplit" name="Run campaign activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track performance in real time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect generated leads in CRM"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SalesFollowUp" name="Follow up with leads"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" name="Campaign period ends">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CampaignWorkJoin" name="Campaign activities complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze performance for future optimization"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Process" name="Analysis complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Task_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Task_DesignVisuals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignWorkSplit" targetRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Task_SalesFollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_SalesFollowUp" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" targetRef="Gateway_CampaignWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_CampaignWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
